messages:
maria: Quick ask for partner inputs — we're locking the cost model for the next SKU wave. Need short rows for each partner SKU/region: supply ramp (reserved units), spot average capacity, spot eviction %, any latency p50 premium (ms), listing fee (USD), and credit window days. Short replies fine.

aj: Can you drop a CSV spec here? partners keep sending different formats.

maria: CSV sample below — please paste rows or attach spreadsheets. Header: sku,region,epoch_start_date,reserved_monthly_units,spot_average_capacity_pct,spot_eviction_rate_pct,latency_p50_ms_premium,listing_fee_usd,credit_window_days
```
sku,region,2026-04-01,1000,25,11,8,350,30
```

lena: We can do EU/US-east. Quick numbers for EU last q: spot_eviction ~12%, latency premium ~8ms on rtx-8x, reserved ramp 1k->3k over 6mo. I'll upload full sheet.

samir: Quick clarification — reserved_monthly_units = committed GPU cards? and spot_average_capacity_pct = percent of our requested capacity served as spot or percent of partner pool?

maria: Good call. reserved_monthly_units = committed GPU-card count (no fractions). spot_average_capacity_pct = expected average % of our requested capacity that partner can serve as spot in steady state (we'll normalize to tokens later).

lena: :thumbsup: for US-east we estimate reserved 2k->5k over 6 months, spot avg 28%, eviction 9%. Will add buckets.

aj: Also flag — marketplace listing fee differs by region and partner. APAC partners quoted higher fees. Do we need partner-specific billing term columns (credit windows / grace)?

maria: Yes. Add listing_fee_usd and credit_window_days. If credit_window_days missing, assume 30. Also helpful: add a 'peak_offpeak_split' column if you have time-of-day curves.

samir: One more ask for partners: can you provide a coarse time-of-day availability curve? e.g., peak hours spot drops to 10% capacity — that changes effective unit economics.

lena: We have 24h curves. For modeling we can provide coarse buckets: peak(08-20UTC)/offpeak. We'll map to peak=08-20UTC, offpeak otherwise and include a peak_multiplier.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: cost-model pipeline triggered with partial inputs — status queued.

maria: Perfect, please ping me once uploaded. Deadline EOD Wed so modeling team can run scenario sims. Thanks all!
